title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E1 — Buddy Hackett, Ruth Buzzi, Richard Pryor
Flip & Pryor are in tenement politics; it’s parent’s night at school; Pryor does stand-up and the whole cast winds up in the hospital.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E2 — Monty Hall, Sandy Duncan, William Windom, The Pointer Sisters
Cast does prop skits; Windom does a dramatic scene and Sandy, the Pointers & Geraldine join Monty on Let's Make A Deal.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E3 — Richard Pryor, Ralph Edwards, Bobby Sandler
Richard Pryor does stand-up and joins Flip for sketches including This Is Your Life Geraldine Jones hosted by Ralph Edwards.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E6 — Robert Goulet, Carol Lawrence, Slappy White
Flip jokes about karate; Slappy White does stand-up and a soft shoe dance joining the whole cast for a burlesque segment.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E4 — James Baldwin - Part 1
Author James Baldwin is interviewed by the young Black poetess Nikki Giovanni in a special two-part presentation of Soul!, taped in London.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E5 — James Baldwin - Part 2
The second installment in a special, two-part program featuring James Baldwin.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E5 — The Strike
The unconventional methods of Webster's teacher earn him an A from the students and a pink slip from an outraged PTA.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E6 — George's Brush With Life
After learning that his buddies from school have died, George quits his job and resolves to live life to the hilt.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E7 — The Importance of Being Worthy
Webster and Nicky's excitement over a fund-raiser they organized fizzles when the proceeds are stolen.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E8 — A Hell of a Weekend
A weekend at Wisconsin Dells with parents of Webster's best friend reveals more than Katherine and George want to see, they are nudists.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E9 — Simple Gifts
Katherine's rich Uncle Charles visits for Christmas. George is worried Webster is forgetting the important part of the season.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E12 — Christmas
When a loan shark comes after Ray's father for a bad debt, the family comes to his rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E13 — Double Double Date
The twins find themselves in double trouble when they switch identities and Tia winds up with two dates for the same party.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E14 — Reality Really Bites
For her film class, Tia "spices up" her family documentary by throwing all sorts of monkey wrenches into their lives.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E15 — The Volunteers
While volunteering at a local retirement home, Tamera becomes determined to help a grumpy old man find happiness again.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E16 — Valentine's Day
Valentine's Day finds Tamera trying to "steal back" her hot date, and Ray and Lisa wondering if the other person is in love with them.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.
